ecosystem.name: RAI Audit Kit
ecosystem.description: A modular audit suite for fairness, robustness, data quality, deep learning, LLM and RAG security, and agent behavior—with evidence reports and CI gates.

packages.name: rai-audit-core
packages.purpose: Audit engine, evidence, reports, and CI gates

packages.name: rai-audit-ml
packages.purpose: Fairness, drift, robustness, and data quality

packages.name: rai-audit-dl
packages.purpose: Image, medical, and scientific AI audits

packages.name: rai-audit-llm
packages.purpose: LLM and RAG safety, grounding, and security

packages.name: rai-audit-agents
packages.purpose: Tool use, memory, permissions, and injection

tools.name: PromptSanitizer
tools.description: Scans AI inputs and outputs for secrets, PII, prompt injection, risky code, and exfiltration patterns.

tools.name: AgentDog
tools.description: CI-friendly tests for agent tool use, grounding, safety, data leakage, prompt injection, and efficiency.

tools.name: CV Quality
tools.description: Audits vision datasets for annotation errors, mislabels, class imbalance, and active-learning priorities.

models.name: vulnerability-researcher
models.description: Fine-tuned Qwen 3.5 35B model for reviewing vulnerability findings, reducing false positives, and producing structured security triage.

models.name: cve-expert
models.description: Fine-tuned DeepSeek-R1 70B model for CVE-worthiness review, exploit-path analysis, and structured vulnerability triage.

models.name: rag-audit-judge
models.description: Fine-tuned local judge for evaluating RAG answer quality, grounding, and retrieval behavior.

models.name: multiagent-orchestrator
models.description: Fine-tuned Llama 3.2 model that routes agents and tools through structured next actions.

models.name: assert-ai
models.description: Fine-tuned Llama 3.2 model for producing structured Python unit-test plans.

models.name: omni-json
models.description: Fine-tuned Llama 3.2 model for deterministic, JSON-only responses in structured AI pipelines.

researchModels.name: galaxy-simplifier
researchModels.description: Generative model for galaxy-image simplification, released with the accompanying astronomy research.

researchModels.name: cornvit
researchModels.description: Image-classification model for hierarchical corn-kernel analysis, released with the CornViT research.
